correctness.rationale: The exact sixfold factorization is certified from two distinct exhaustive encodings (bit-adjacency edge recurrence versus 4x4 row cuts), each covering all 65536 subsets of each graph and agreeing on all (cardinality, cut) coefficients. A 35-term difference dictionary equals the binomial expansion of the claimed polynomial. The positivity comparison follows from the vertex and endpoint values of an explicit quadratic on \(s\ge2\), and the physical field limits follow from \(q=e^{2\beta J}\), \(s=2\cosh(4\beta h)\). The public proof specifies all assumptions and boundaries. Computations remain finite and do not claim infinite-volume results.

value.rationale: The two smallest classical examples with identical strongly regular parameters and adjacency spectrum are a canonical setting for asking what field response is not determined by spectrum. The exact factorization proves two strict, temperature-uniform reversals of the ordered antiferromagnetic partition functions as magnetic field increases, despite the previously-known fixed zero-field order. The crossover fields converge to distinct nonzero energetic scales \(J\) and \(3J\). This adds physically interpretable structure not encoded by zero-field counts, while carefully limiting the conclusion to a finite graph pair.
